sections.description:
THE WAPDA (CHAIRMAN AND MEMBERS) SERVICE RULES, 1972
THE WAPDA (CHAIRMAN AND MEMBERS) SERVICE RULES, 1972
(Gazette of Pakistan,
Extra. Part II, dated 23rd October, 1972)
Notification
No. S.R.O. 966 (1)/72.--- In exercise of the powers conferred by
section 5 of the West Pakistan Water and Power Development Authority Act, 1958
(West Pakistan Act XXXI of 1958), read with paragraph (a) of clause (1) of
Article 12 of the Province of West Pakistan (Dissolution) Order, 1970 (P.O. No.
1 of 1970), the President is pleased to make the following Rules, namely:---‑
1. Short title and commencement.--- (1) These
Rules may be called the West Pakistan Water and Power Development Authority
(Chairman and Members) Service Rules, 1972.
(2) They shall come into force at once.
2. Definitions.-- Unless the context otherwise requires, the words and expressions
used in these Rules and defined in the West Pakistan Water and Power Development
Authority Act, 1958 (West Pakistan Act XXXI of 1958), of the Fundamental Rules
or the Supplementary Rules or the Civil Service Regulations or the General
Financial Rules for the time being in force shall have the same meanings as are
respectively assigned to them in the said Act. Rules or Regulation, as the case
may be.
3. Remuneration.-- The following pay and allowances shall be admissible to the
Chairman, namely:---
(A) CHAIRMAN:---
(1) Pay--- (i)
If a serving Government servant is appointed as
Chairman pay admissible to a Secretary to the Federal Government in the scale of
pay to which the Government servant is entitled.
(ii) If a
non-official is appointed as Chairman such pay as may be determined by the
President.
(iii) If a
retired Government Servant is appointed as Chairman pay
admissible to a Secretary to the Federal Government in the prescribed scale of
pay, pension being held in abeyance.
2. Sumptuary allowance.---
The sumptuary allowance shall be regulated in accordance with the orders issued
by the Federal Government from time to time.
3. House and House Rent.---
Residential accommodation will be provided on the scale laid down by the Punjab
Government for Officers of the same status or pay and under the same conditions
and the rent shall be charged on the basis laid down by the Federal Government
for its-employees.
4. Car allowance.---
No car allowance will be admissible and no car will be made available for the
private use of the Chairman. But if the Federal Government is of the opinion,
that the officer has to tour extensively at his headquarters and no staff car
is made available to him for this purpose it may sanction such car allowance
not exceeding Rs. 250 per month as it may deem fit in
order to compensate him for the local journeys performed by him on official
business in his private car.
(B) Members:---
(1) Pay--- (i) If
a serving Government servant is appointed as Member:
Pay admissible
to a Joint Secretary to she Federal Government in the scale of pay to which the
Government servants entitled;
(ii) If a non-official is appointed as
Member Such payment may be determined by the
President.
(iii) If a retired Government servant is
appointed as Member; pay admissible to a Joint Secretary to the Federal
Government in the prescribed scale of pay, pension being held in abeyance.
(2) House and House Rent.---
Residential accommodation will be provided on the scale laid down by the
Government for Officers of the same status or pay and under the same conditions
and the rent shall be charged on the basis laid down by the Federal Government
for its employees.
